description: Katasterübersichtskarte - Verkehr, Brücken is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Freistaat Sachsen. Die Katasterübersichtskarte (KUEK5) ist ein speziell für Dresden entwickelter Geobasisdatenbestand (Grundlagenkarte) und bildet das Stadtgebiet der Landeshauptstadt Dresden mit Hilfe ausgewählter, zum Teil generalisierter Daten aus dem Amtlichen Liegenschaftskatasterinformationssystem (ALKIS) im Maßstab 1:5.000 ab. Darstellung der Brücken (ab einer Breite von 1 m) im Stadtgebiet der Landeshauptstadt Dresden. Coverage: Freistaat Sachsen. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Freistaat Sachsen. Its tags are lokal, opendata. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
